verdict.rationale: An in-dashboard assistant is a plausible capability for a SaaS search platform, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant that an Algolia user can hand tasks to. Agent Studio is a builder for end-user-facing assistants such as shopping assistants and conversational search grounded in the customer's indices. The agent skills and MCP server serve external agents rather than providing an in-product assistant.
